en.topic_title: China artists quit S.Korea art show after organisers let ‘Taiwan’ be used in name of exhibition
en.topic_summary:
Chinese artists withdrew from a major South Korean art show after organisers allowed “Taiwan” to be used in the name of an exhibition, officials said Thursday, as China issued a rebuke.



Gwangju Biennale. Photo: Gwangju Biennale.



The Gwangju Biennale, one of Asia’s largest contemporary art events, is due to open Saturday, with its Pavilion Project bringing together artists from around the world at venues across the southwestern city.
